## 4. Custom Aspects

```yaml
custom_aspects:
  - name: "Data Pipeline Safety"
    tier: 1
    check: "Changes to src/config/constants.ts product/category arrays should note whether they will be overwritten by npm run sync. Manual edits to auto-generated sections are a risk."
    trigger: advisory

  - name: "Client Component Boundary"
    tier: 2
    check: "New components in src/app/ or src/sections/ should be Server Components by default. 'use client' should only be added when browser APIs, event handlers, or React hooks (useState/useEffect) are required."
    trigger: advisory

  - name: "Cart State Integrity"
    tier: 1
    check: "Any code that reads from or writes to localStorage 'packing_cart' must have try/catch error handling and schema validation. Cart mutations must go through cartReducer dispatch — never direct state mutation."
    trigger: blocker

  - name: "Static Asset References"
    tier: 2
    check: "New image paths in components must use next/image (not <img> tags). Remote image hostnames must be whitelisted in next.config.ts. Local images in /public must be referenced with leading slash."
    trigger: advisory
```
